trigger.prompt: Process only one immutable approved install_patches payload with schema_version 1.1, reboot_setting IfRequired, and maximum_duration PT2H. Validate equality of subscription_id, target_id, target_kind, patch_ids, operation, approver, and snapshot hash before any tool. The API has authoritatively validated approval time at dispatch; treat approval.decision=approved in the accepted immutable envelope as current and do not independently infer current time or expiry. Reject any missing, non-approved, or mismatched approval field. The target must be one canonical top-level Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines or Microsoft.HybridCompute/machines ID matching target_kind and the supplied subscription. Invoke the bound read skill first using only RunAzCliReadCommands and its fixed bounded PatchAssessmentResources query. Require no more than 257 rows, PT24H freshness, exactly one latest assessment parent with a nonempty activity ID, the read query's own outcome-field parent/activity/timestamp generation correlation logic, and every and only selected KB. Acceptance is governed entirely by the read query's returned outcome and blockers fields: a softwarePatches child row may have empty child_activity_id because Azure does not populate assessmentActivityId on those child resources, and empty child_activity_id must be accepted, never independently re-blocked, when outcome is applicable and blockers are empty. Require direct same-run structured evidence with outcome applicable, blockers empty, exact subscription/target/KB membership, and observed_at no more than PT5M old and not future. On any invalid, unavailable, stale, ambiguous, partial, extra, cross-kind, or mismatched input or evidence, stop blocked_no_action. Then invoke the bound write skill using only RunAzCliWriteCommands. Invoke RunAzCliWriteCommands exactly once with exactly one target-kind-specific command. Autonomous submission is allowed only because the dispatching API has already bound explicit human approval to this immutable payload. Never present the command only in prose, create a userQuestion, ask for a chat response, call SubmitMessage, or create another approval layer. For Azure VM use exactly az vm install-patches --ids <target_id> --kb-numbers-to-include <exact IDs> --maximum-duration PT2H --reboot-setting IfRequired --no-wait. For Arc use exactly az connectedmachine install-patches --ids <target_id> --windows-parameters '{"kbNumbersToInclude":[...]}' --maximum-duration PT2H --reboot-setting IfRequired --no-wait true. Forbid empty filters, classifications, discovery, alternate targets or patches, shell use, another argument, a second command, fallback, and retry. A completed thread proves submission with the write skill's exact typed provider_operation. If a successful empty-output --no-wait command lacks typed provider_operation, ambiguous submission terminates submission_ambiguous without retry; only the dispatching runtime may recover provider proof through its own read-only evidence chain. Azure Activity Log may establish accepted-submission context for the exact target, exact installPatches operation type, write-attempt time window, and unambiguous single accepted/succeeded correlation ID, but the durable provider operation/result ID must come from one unambiguous Azure Resource Graph patchinstallationresources parent patchInstallationResults/<id> row whose start time is after the write attempt, whose status/counts indicate success, and whose child softwarePatches rows prove every and only selected KB is Installed. Never parse free-form prose as patch-success evidence. Activity Log recovery alone proves only accepted submission, never durable operation identity or patch success. Provider completion never substitutes for refreshed selected-KB reconciliation.
